snippet.title: Emberville - New Gameplay Trailer - Convergence Showcase
snippet.description:
Awaken with no memories inside the Vitromotus, a vast underground world created as a magical dungeon where death no longer lasts. Explore its depths, battle dangerous creatures, rescue survivors, and rebuild the ruined town of Emberville while uncovering the truth behind this prison.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2295170/Emberville/
